changelog: Fix: importing a closed Bitfunded position could insert a duplicate trade instead of updating an existing open manual row, because entry_price/pnl/time_in are all NULL on a never-matched manual row and every condition in the match query silently excludes a NULL column under SQL three-valued logic rather than matching or erroring. New BitfundedImportController::matchOpenRow() second match branch finds such a row by pair+direction+trade_date (+-1 day fallback) and, only when present, entry_price within 0.5% -- routes to the existing (confirmed-safe) update path, which never touches notes/emotions/gate tags/session/SL/screenshots

Add: entry_price returns to the manual trade form (Outcome section) as an optional, paste-friendly field -- normalizeEntryPriceInput() strips a trailing currency label client-side; TradeController::saveTrade() rejects a non-numeric or non-positive value outright rather than silently storing 0 or garbage (a stored 0 would satisfy the importer's own legacy corruption-tolerance branch and match the wrong row)

Add: an amber 'Add fill price' badge on any open Trade Log row with entry_price IS NULL, and a loud, explicit preview warning ('{pair} {direction} -- open trade found with no entry price...') whenever an import resolves against such a row, matched or ambiguous -- never silently falls through to 'new'

Fix: BitfundedImportController::reconciliation() reported a false balance mismatch of roughly the locked margin whenever positions were open, because Bitfunded's reported balance excludes open-position margin while the derived balance doesn't. Now adds open positions' planned_margin back before comparing, or reports comparison_unavailable instead of a false flagged mismatch when that margin isn't fully known

Add: trades.funding (nullable, un-backfilled) -- per-trade funding cost derived from Transaction History's real Open Position/Close Position rows (bf_attribute_funding() in bitfunded_parser.php: open_margin - returned_margin + pnl, isolated margin only, verified against real data to the cent). Exact-timestamp match first, +-60s fallback, never 'nearest' beyond that, never a pick among ambiguous candidates -- an unbounded nearest-in-time search would confidently attribute the wrong position's margin event. Not sign-clamped: funding can reduce a trader's cost (paid to hold), and net_pnl (= pnl - fees - COALESCE(funding,0)) can increase from it. No existing rows backfilled or recomputed; challenges.funding_adjustment and the reconciliation preview's own arithmetic are deliberately unchanged, to avoid double-counting the same funding at both the per-trade and challenge-level layers

Verify: bitfunded_parser.php's Transaction History self-test rebuilt from a verbatim real paste (the previous fixture's 'Realized PnL' Type does not exist in real data) -- 63 assertions, including the real TRX/BNB funding derivation and four synthetic edge cases for the match-tightening rules above
